fields.label: Source Warehouse
fields.description: Our own warehouse - Greige fabric is issued FROM here to the dyer.

fields.label: Target Warehouse
fields.description: The dyer's warehouse - Greige fabric is received here on Issue Fabric, and consumed from here on Dyeing Receipt's Repack entry.

fields.label: Total Issue Qty (Pcs)
fields.description: Sum of Issued Qty across Items - updated automatically by Issue Fabric.

fields.label: Total Rolls Issued
fields.description: Sum of Rolls (Issued) across Items - updated automatically by Issue Fabric.

fields.label: Total Weight Issued (LBS)
fields.description: Sum of Weight (kg) (Issued) across Items - updated automatically by Issue Fabric.

fields.label: Total Received Qty (Pcs)
fields.description: Sum of Received Qty across Items - updated automatically when a Dyeing Receipt referencing this contract is submitted.

fields.label: Total Rolls Received
fields.description: Sum of Rolls (Received) across Items - updated automatically when a Dyeing Receipt referencing this contract is submitted.

fields.label: Total Weight Received (LBS)
fields.description: Sum of Weight (kg) (Received) across Items - updated automatically when a Dyeing Receipt referencing this contract is submitted.

fields.label: Balance (Pcs)
fields.description: = Total Issue Qty - Total Received Qty. What's still out at the dyer and not yet received back.

fields.label: Balance (Rolls)
fields.description: = Total Rolls Issued - Total Rolls Received.

fields.label: Balance (Weight LBS)
fields.description: = Total Weight Issued - Total Weight Received.

fields.label: Sales Order
fields.description: Internal - the Sales Order this was created from, via its 'Create Dyeing Contract' button.
